clips.title: Front kick
clips.summary: 4 key moments: ready -> right kick extended -> right leg lowered -> right kick extended -> standing stance -> finish

clips.title: Squat jump
clips.summary: 6 key moments, 2 jumps: ready -> crouch left arm forward -> jump -> land -> left leg landing stance -> deep crouch -> rising left arm back -> jump -> land -> crouch left arm forward -> standing left foot back (finish)

clips.title: Jumping jacks
clips.summary: 11 key moments: ready -> arms overhead -> standing arms down -> arms overhead -> standing arms down -> arms overhead -> standing arms down -> midair arms wide -> arms overhead -> standing arms down -> arms overhead -> standing arms down (finish)

clips.title: Lunge
clips.summary: 13 key moments: ready -> right foot forward -> right kneeling lunge -> standing rise -> feet together stance -> left knee lifted -> left foot forward -> left kneeling lunge -> standing rise -> feet together stance -> right foot forward -> right kneeling lunge -> standing rise -> neutral standing (finish)

clips.title: Punches
clips.summary: 7 key moments: ready -> boxing guard stance -> right punch extended -> right cross extended -> right punch extended -> right cross extended -> right punch extended -> hands lowered (finish)
